subject: general
question: In a certain code language, PAINT is written as QZHOU and BASK is written as CZTL. How will MOVIE be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Step1: All consonants are coded as the next alphabet.**

 
• **Consonants + 1**

**Step2: All vowels are coded as the previous alphabet.**

 
• **Vowel - 1**

PAINT is written as QZHOU.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/461df73448af432100fa50db020c9d43c8924b12fb31926a46921244ec64f3df.png] 

And,

BASK is written as CZTL.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e75c418262c743c76093ce1b8379278d32bb3895411728bf6843a64d05591b5a.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/408ff5f62178351ed26691729703879040e13ceb850abbaac4a4aa13e44f7610.png] 

Hence, 'MOVIE' is coded as "**NNWHD**".
